newsitem.title: USA: Mycogen Q3 hurt by charge, legal expenses.
newsitem.headline: Mycogen Q3 hurt by charge, legal expenses.

text.p: Mycogen Corp, which Tuesday reported income of $0.02 per share for the third quarter ended May 31 compared with $0.11 per share last year, said that the period was hurt by charges of $8.6 million or $0.28 per share and legal expenses of $2.2 million or $0.07 per share.

The special charges related to severance payments and non-cash stock compensation to its former chief executive, the company said, and the legal expenses were for patent litigation and interference proceedings.

For the nine months ended May 31, total revenues were $177.2 million, compared with $132.2 million in the prior year period. The company said the increase reflected higher seed sales mainly attributable to the acquisition of United AgriSeeds in February 1996 and Morgan Seeds in October 1996.
